long_biography.plain_text:
Dimitra Filippou joined the board of FAGE Greece in 2002 as the dairy group was extending its international reach. Her parallel appointments included Evga Holding, Agan and Palace, where she ultimately served thirteen years as chair. Those posts placed her across the governance of manufacturing, food and corporate-service companies without assigning her daily operating responsibility.

Filippou was married to Kyriakos Filippou, who developed FAGE with his brother Ioannis. They had two children, Athanassios-Kyros and Eleni, both connected to the next generation of family business and social life. Filippou remained on FAGE's Greek board in 2024. The company consistently described the position as non-executive, a distinction that separated her contribution from management and from beneficial ownership held at family level.
